parsed.name: 是德科技 DSO-X 3xx4A 四通道数字示波器
parsed.description: 这是一款台式四通道数字示波器，用于采集、显示和分析电信号波形。它常用于电子实验、电路调试与故障排查，可帮助用户观察信号的幅度、时间关系和稳定性，并进行常见波形测量与统计分析。
parsed.description_en: This is a bench-top 4-channel digital oscilloscope used to acquire, display, and analyze electrical waveforms. It is commonly used in electronics labs for circuit debugging, troubleshooting, and signal characterization, helping users inspect amplitude, timing behavior, signal stability, and common waveform measurements with statistical analysis.

actions.description: 获取示波器自动测量结果的统计信息。
actions.description_en: Get statistical information for the oscilloscope's automatic measurement results.
